purpose: Tie-aware adaptive human evaluation with design-based estimation and a sealed audit.

stages.name: acquire
stages.objective: Freeze the weighted item frame, rater panel, rubric, model pair, response coupling, and audit seed.
inputs: Approved entries and exact revisions from experiments/public_source_registry.json
Frozen eval section of experiments/pilot_preregistration.json
Verified preflight data/content manifests, passing content-readiness ledger, and retained role-file hashes from hash-pinned local JSONL exports
Timestamped deployment-log sample or weighted benchmark frame
Rater recruitment definition, target weights, consent, compensation, and withdrawal protocol
Evaluated model, tokenizer, decoder, prompt-generator, and jury revisions
checks: Target item, prompt, response, rater, and display-order masses sum to one
The frame contains 200 reasoning, 200 math, and 128 coding roots with one-third source mass
frame_manifest.json lists 528 unique row_uid values with per-root mass 1/(3*n_source)
Stable row, raw-content, and normalized-content hashes are recorded before frame sampling
The frozen PII, secret, and lexical near-duplicate gates report no retained-content finding; passing is not represented as semantic or privacy clearance
The acquisition manifest embeds the preflight manifest and retained role-file hashes
Personal data and unsupported licenses are excluded
The sealed target-random audit seed and cells are inaccessible to acquisition

stages.name: process
stages.objective: Deduplicate roots, generate frozen paired responses, randomize display, and validate the rating interface.
inputs: acquire/frame_manifest.json
Prompt-variant weights, response seeds, coupling rule, and semantic-cluster threshold
Rubric, tie subtypes, skip reasons, and sensitive-content warnings
Frozen experiments/content_gates.json, its hash-bound ledger, and a reviewed paraphrase/template-leakage audit
For more than 4096 retained rows, a frozen reviewed exact engine and hash-bound external-overlap shards covering every unordered pair
checks: Every retained normalized duplicate cluster is assigned wholly to one frame unit or excluded
Any external lexical audit attests exactly n*(n-1)/2 gap-free pair ordinals, while a disk-backed exact shared-5-gram join independently reproduces every qualifying pair
The cell manifest embeds the passing content-readiness ledger hash and accounts for every scanned record with an included partition or explicit exclusion reason
Audit attempts are independent draws from the full target mass; hidden audit membership never removes a target unit from adaptive support
AB and BA renders strip model identifiers and preserve content
Assignment attempts, nonresponse, latency, and tie subtype have explicit fields

stages.name: build
stages.objective: Fit the prequential tie-aware jury model and freeze the EVI approximation and exploration mixture.
inputs: process/cell_manifest.json
Pilot-only labels, priors, identifiability constraints, EVI temperature, and epsilon
Decision margin, normalized loss matrix, fixed Bayes-action tie order, frozen Newton/Laplace hypothetical update, batch size, and annotation costs
checks: Predictions and draw probabilities are frozen before each outcome batch
Q_b and predictive probabilities use the same 4096 frozen Laplace-posterior draws
Each hypothetical outcome applies the frozen damped Newton mode/Hessian update before recomputing state mass
Posterior, frame-functional, and Newton-implementation hashes equal the frozen preregistration hashes
Working-posterior Bayes-risk EVI is computed before p_b and does not call the terminal confidence-set action
The judge-cell overlap graph is connected and both orders are represented
Every target unit satisfies the logged positivity floor

stages.name: train
stages.objective: Run preregistered simulations, then acquire fixed-budget human pilot and adaptive ratings without optional stopping.
inputs: build/evaluation_model_manifest.json
Frozen 189-condition fractional screening layout, two-thousand trials per condition, and deterministic condition/policy Monte Carlo seeds
Complete-response protocol plus nonresponse bounds and sensitivity models
checks: Each draw logs pi, p_t, model revision, EVI, outcome, and pre-outcome timestamp
validate_eval_simulation_design.py reproduces the 16 orthogonal main-effect rows, zero main--two-factor aliases, center/local-alternative blocks, 189 unique conditions, and condition seeds
Executable DGPs, missingness laws, baseline policies, and estimator implementations match replacement-preregistration hashes; the frozen layout alone does not clear this blocker
Simulation covers decision boundaries, dependence, misspecification, small propensities, nonresponse, and drift without attempting the infeasible full Cartesian crossing
T counts all preassigned slots; a cap, withdrawal, or nonresponse records R_t=0, never triggers replacement, and does not stop later slots

stages.name: evaluate
stages.objective: Freeze analysis, open the audit once, and report intervals, decisions, missingness bounds, and shift diagnostics.
inputs: train/acquisition_ledger.jsonl
Frozen z_0.975 constant, clipping to [-1,1], practical margin, and replacement-preregistered covariance rule and equivalence margin
Frozen epsilon-dependent worst-case nonresponse interval and response-drift gamma grid
Sealed audit outcomes and temporal-wave bridge design
checks: Estimator, martingale variance, maximum weight, and ESS reproduce from the ledger
Any nonresponse switches the primary decision to the two one-sided martingale-Hoeffding endpoint bounds
All 200 audit slots remain; audit nonresponses use the frozen -1/+1 endpoint means and Hoeffding radius
Adaptive-minus-audit uncertainty includes shared-rater covariance
Tie subtypes, abstentions, nonresponse bounds, all domains, and negative results are retained
